name: sorceress_generate_image
description: Generate an image with a Sorceress image model and save it into the project (default assets/sorceress/). Credits are deducted from the API key owner's Sorceress account automatically; cost varies by model, resolution/quality, and reference images. Call sorceress_list_tools first if unsure which model to use or what it costs. This waits for completion and returns the saved file path(s).

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16". Must be supported by the chosen model.

params.description: Model-specific options that affect cost, e.g. {"resolution":"2K"} or {"quality":"high"}.

ref_images.description: Optional publicly-reachable reference image URLs (for models that support image input).

save_dir.description: Optional project-relative folder to save into (default "assets/sorceress").
